run_scenario_test: run all registered ARE simulation scenarios with a 60 second time limit in oracle mode
test_scenario_folders: test that scenario folders have correct naming, a README.md, and a scenario.py file
check_function_calls: check if a scenario Python file contains a call to the run_and_validate function
test_all_scenarios_not_empty: test that the ALL_SCENARIOS registry contains at least one registered scenario type
test_all_scenarios_init: test that all non-universe and non-gaia scenario classes can be instantiated successfully
